evidence.source_statement: For distributable applications or libraries, provide appropriate downloadable release assets through authorized zero-cost hosting where feasible; do not require binaries for source-only products.
source_conditions: A user-authorized MVP review, inauguration or post-MVP maintenance operation is taking place.
source_exceptions: No implicit authorization to publish tags, releases or deployments.
